reasons.text: The label photo is the same image (same sha256) as a photo on another claim in the program, e740dd5b-4943-53e4-8d83-1587067923b1. A shared photo triggers a flag under the claim policy, so this claim goes to review before any decision.
The label is legible and shows model SE4570, which is a recalled model.
The date code 07/22 is within the recalled date codes.
Purchase from www.grainger.com on 2023-07-31 is inside the sale window and from a listed retailer. No receipt is required.
The serial check was skipped because the program has no serial rule, so it did not affect the outcome.
